correctness.rationale: For any odd prime p, eliminate the two baseline rows to separate frequency parity. In homogeneous blocks, a three-row prime Fourier minor has rank three. In 3+1 splits the 3-by-3 Vandermonde Fourier minor proves invertibility. In 2+2 splits the Schur complement is a 2-by-2 matrix of cyclotomic differences with determinant equal to two nonzero factors times a factor vanishing exactly when the parity-pair sums agree. This Schur complement has rank at least one, so all singular partners have rank exactly three. For each of p pair sums there are (p−1)/2 distinct unordered pairs per parity, giving p(p−1)^2/4 singular balanced partners, plus 2 C(p,4) homogeneous sets. Exact determinant arithmetic from the packaged checker succeeds for all 4-subsets at p=3,5,7,11,13. Finite checks corroborate but do not prove arbitrary p. The packaged checker also enumerates row and column proportionality via exact parity/sign and residue-phase labels; the nonproportional singular totals are 3,20,63,275,468, exactly p(p−1)^2/4.
